videos.title: Posted @withregram • @keithallanduh Hey Z Whackers! Z Nation season 6 teaser. I’m very excited at last to share this with all of you. This is a concept for an animated season of Z-Nation utilizing the original cast voicing the characters. Although we did utilize AI for the teaser, our goal is to create the season, using artists hand drawn images and motion capture. If you are hungry for more of Z-Nation, regardless of whether or not you think animation is the way to go, please sign the petition in my bio. It is only through the full force of the fan base demanding more that there will be any hope of seeing more episodes of Z Nation. Truly, it is up to you.  Thanks to my partner. @mykstone for all the hard work that he has put into this and to @alvinmurphyduh for editing this piece #znation #znationmurphy #znationsyfy #znationreborn #znationseason6
